wiki.title: Eric Koch (politician)
wiki.extract: Eric Koch (born 1968/1969) is an American attorney and politician serving as a member of the Indiana Senate from Senate District 44. He previously represented the 65th district in the Indiana House of Representatives from 2002 to 2016.
